project: Before the Rain / 雨来之前
direction: Original bold-outline garden cartoon: rounded leaves, large expressive eyes, warm cream and honey, three garden sets. Code-native vector drawing; no bitmap generation or imported reference assets.

code_native_art.source: Original project procedural drawing, revised by Codex following user direction toward playful garden cartoons.
states: solid leaf stem with three value bands
diamond dew reward vs round moving spray hazards
sunny vegetable garden/fountain bridge/rainy tool garden
warm tree-hollow ending; up to nine blossoms from optional collection
code_native_art.collision_contract: Model authoritative. Solid stem silhouette stays within the original rectangle; visual tips taper inward. Decorative thin stems and distant garden objects have no collision. Flower direction, charge threshold, stamina eligibility and shelter location share model values. Reward dew is angular and sparkling; damaging spray is round and moving. Sprayer states read sprayer_phase directly.
code_native_art.frame: Godot 4.6.2, Compatibility renderer, 1280x800 logical frame, keep-aspect, code-native AA outlines; no bitmap texture budget.

ui.source: Project Godot drawing and controls in main.gd; operating-system Chinese font fallback
ui.stamina: Five 20-point segments, numeric current stamina, pending burst cost highlight and delayed loss trail
ui.clock: Elapsed journey time in acts 1-2; 55-second exposed-time budget in act 3, paused under shelter

rejected_pass.status: Removed from source/runtime/export following user feedback SF-R02: AI feeling too strong.
rejected_pass.retention: Original unchanged images, full image-generation prompts/provenance, native captures and interim app retained only in local outputs/swarm-flight/2026-10-20-finished-chapter/rejected-painted-pass; not required at runtime.

validation.engine: Godot 4.6.2 stable, OpenGL Compatibility on Apple M1 Pro
validation.result: Developer inspected actual native renders at 1280x800. Lead selected the first-frame visual direction; states, reward/hazard shapes and all three scene palettes reviewed. Full user playthrough and musical listening response remain pending. No commercial-art acceptance claimed.

style_references.use: Broad garden-cartoon visual reference only; no characters, sprites, logos or screenshots are shipped.
Official soundtrack context for light, playful garden mood; no audio download, transcription or melody reuse.

audio.source: Original deterministic PCM synthesis authored in project code. No external samples, recordings or transcriptions.
audio.arrangements: Three original eight-bar / 32-beat A/B arrangements, 64 eighth-note slots. Offbeat plucks, toy keys/wooden mallets, alternating bass root/fifth, light percussion. Third act shifts to minor harmony and denser pulse.
audio.mix: Fixed synthesis gain 1.45; 1.2s stage music crossfade, 4dB event duck, retained mute and fixed 8-voice SFX pool.
audio.verification_output: SWARM_AUDIO_DIR or OS cache directory/before-the-rain-audio-qa; three WAVs and signal-report.json. PCM checks are technical evidence, not human listening acceptance.
